# B"H
<!-- Boruch Hashem -->
<!-- Blessed is He -->

# Node 18 Restoration Compatibility Delta

> The Awtsmoos keeps one browser scroll and one server vessel in truthful accord;
> Awtsmoos.com names the module format explicitly where old inference cannot be trusted as lord.

## Observed Failure

Production deployment succeeded on commit `f80f026c091385b5e6367d172e28348b6400addb`, but the model restoration stopped before credential creation. Node `v18.19.1` classified `RemoteModelRecords.js` as CommonJS because the repository package boundary does not declare ESM, while the local newer Node inferred ESM syntax.

## Safety Evidence

- Failure occurred during module instantiation, before `withTemporaryDriveCredential()` executed.
- No temporary Drive credential or upload was created.
- Production Node 18 successfully imported an explicit `data:text/javascript` ESM module.
- `RemoteModelRecords.js` has no imports, so loading its complete source through a base64 data URL preserves its exact exports without path-resolution ambiguity.

## Authorized Correction

1. Rewrite `scripts/mitzvah-world/modelDriveManifest.mjs` in full.
2. Read `RemoteModelRecords.js` as UTF-8 source.
3. Import that source through an explicit base64 `data:text/javascript` URL.
4. Preserve the browser module, CompactJS graph, model identities, hashes, and paths unchanged.
5. Run local syntax and all nineteen hash verifications.
6. Commit only the manifest adapter.
7. Push, immutably deploy, and rerun the server restoration.
8. Verify all nineteen public and immutable model doors before browser testing.
